a11y_description: MAD Launcher isebenzisa ukufinyelela kuphela ukuze ugcine izinkinobho zesaziso nezilungiselelo ezisheshayo kubha yokuzulazula kuyilapho usebenzisa ezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza. Ayifundi okuqukethwe kwesikrini sakho.
action_box_words_hint: Amagama kunoma yiluphi ulimi olusebenzisa lo myalo
action_box_commands_intro: Thepha umyalo ukuze uhlele amagama awo nezinhlelo zokusebenza. Ungasusa izinqamuleli zesiNgisi ezakhelwe ngaphakathi nge-×.
action_box_command_at_sub: Izinhlelo zokusebenza zokuthumela imiyalezo ne-imeyili, kanye namagama afana nomlayezo ne-imeyili
action_box_command_apps_words_sub: Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikulo myalo nezinqamuleli zolimi
action_box_command_words_only_sub: Izinqamuleli zolimi — thepha okuthi × ukuze ususe ngisho nezakhelwe ngaphakathi
action_box_command_search_sub: Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezinebhokisi lokusesha langempela langaphakathi nohlelo
action_box_command_help_sub: /h. Iwindi losizo lingaphansi kokuthi Okungeziwe → Okokuhlola
action_box_command_update_sub: Ivula i-GetApps noma i-Google Play Isitolo ukuze ukwazi ukubuyekeza konke
action_box_update_edit_hint: Ivula uhlu lwezibuyekezo zesitolo. I-Android ayikwazi ukubuyekeza zonke izinhlelo zokusebenza ezivela ku-MAD ngaphandle kokuvula isitolo.
action_box_search_edit_hint: : ibala kuphela izinhlelo zokusebenza ezidalula ukusesha kwangaphakathi nohlelo (Ikhalenda, i-YouTube, nokunye okufanayo). Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezingenalo ibhokisi lokusesha azihlali.
action_box_search_none: Azikho izinhlelo zokusebenza eziseshekayo ezitholakala kule foni.
action_box_remove_builtin_hint: Thepha okuthi × ukuze ususe igama, okufaka phakathi izinqamuleli zesiNgisi ezakhelwe ngaphakathi ezifana ne-msg noma /h.
action_box_help_edit_hint: Iwindi losizo elintantayo lihlala livaliwe ngaphandle kwalapho ulivula kokuthi Okungeziwe → Okokuhlola. /h ihlelwe lapha.
action_box_open_updates_sub: GetApps noma i-Google Play Isitolo — thepha Buyekeza konke lapho
action_box_your_commands_hint: Thayipha igama elinqamuleli. Vula uhlelo lokusebenza, noma sebenzisa inhlanganisela esheshayo efana ne-@WhatsApp ngoxhumana naye osevele ukhethiwe.
action_box_on_this_phone_hint: Le miyalo ayivuli olunye uhlelo lokusebenza. Thinta igama ukuze ulishintshe (isibonelo /s → okunamathelayo), × ukuze ulisuse, noma wengeze elinye igama.
action_box_command_words_hint: Amagama emiyalo eyakhelwe ngaphakathi. Eyakho/d, yenza, namathela imiyalo yezithombe ikumiyalo Yakho engenhla.
action_box_no_apps_drag: Azikho izinhlelo zokusebenza — engeza noma hudula lapha
action_box_all_apps_in_command: Lonke uhlelo lokusebenza olufakiwe seluvele likulo myalo.
action_box_command_reminder_sub: Ivula iWashi. /r milk in 20 min, noma pickup at 8pm
action_box_command_launcher_settings_sub: Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhethwayo, kanye nokusethwa kwezimvume &.
action_box_command_abs_sub: Imiyalo yakho, amagama akhelwe ngaphakathi, uhlu lwezinhlelo zokusebenza, nezimvume.
action_box_pill_color_sub: Background of the dock pill and field
action_box_text_color_sub: Text and icons inside the pill
action_box_command_contact_sub: & then a name — pick who, then message or call
action_box_shortcut_need_words: Thayipha igama noma /d, yenza, namathisela isithombe
action_box_grants_intro: Ibhokisi lesenzo lidinga lezi zimvume ukuze uthumele umlayezo, ushayele ucingo, uthumele, futhi ugcine okunamathiselwe esikrinini
help_add_command_desc: Izilungiselelo → Imiyalo yakho. Vula uhlelo lokusebenza, noma inhlanganisela esheshayo (@ / ! / #) ngohlelo lokusebenza noxhumana naye osevele ukhethiwe.
settings_hub_docks_subtitle: Ubude, izithonjana, ukufihla okuzenzakalelayo, Ibhokisi lesenzo nezinkinobho ze-Apps
extras_language_follows_system: Ibhokisi lesenzo lisebenzisa ulimi lwefoni kumamenyu nosizo lomyalo.
emergency_confirm: Ivula isidayeli. Qinisekisa kuhlelo lokusebenza lwefoni.
send_sms_direct: Ithumela nge-%1$s ngaphandle kokuvula uhlelo lokusebenza
via_app_opens: Ivula i-%1$s nombhalo olungile (thepha okuthi Thumela lapho)
actionbox_ott_calls_disabled: Isilayezi, iTelegramu, nezinye izingcingo zohlelo lokusebenza azisekelwa — thepha ukuze uthole imininingwane kokuthi Akusebenzi.
translate_hint: Zama: kusukela kusi-english kuya ku-Spanish sawubona
translate_hint_word: Type the word, then pick a language below
translate_compose_banner: Humusha — thayipha umbhalo, bese ukhetha uhlelo lokusebenza
notes_compose_banner: Qaphela — thayipha umbhalo, bese ukhetha uhlelo lokusebenza
ai_compose_banner: Buza i-AI — thayipha umbuzo wakho, bese ukhetha umsizi
nav_compose_banner: Hamba — thayipha indawo, bese ukhetha Maps noma Waze
note_press_enter: Cindezela u-Enter ukuze uthole okunamathelayo, noma thayipha kuqala
placeholder_search_contacts: Sesha othintana nabo bakamuva noma ocingweni...
placeholder_pick_at: Khetha uhlelo lokusebenza, bese oxhumana naye ukuze uvule…
placeholder_pick_social: Khetha uhlelo lokusebenza lokuxhumana nabantu ukuze uvule...
placeholder_search_contacts_or_number: Sesha izingxoxo zakamuva noma thayipha inombolo...
placeholder_video_call: Sesha izingxoxo zakamuva noma thayipha inombolo yevidiyo…
placeholder_reminder: /r milk in 20 min, noma pickup at 8pm
placeholder_navigate: /g bese ubeka indawo, noma nav / iya kokuthi
news_pick_sources: Khetha izinhlelo zokusebenza zezindaba nabashicileli ukuze ugcwalise leli khasi.
news_no_stories: Azikho izindaba okwamanje. Khetha imithombo, noma vula uhlelo lokusebenza lwezindaba ukuze i-MAD ikwazi ukuthatha izihloko zayo.
notif_enable_access: Nika amandla ukufinyelela kwesaziso ngezithonjana ezingafundiwe bukhoma
qs_hint_tap_replace: Hambisa amathayili, thepha okuthi × ukuze ufihle, noma thepha ithayela bese elitholakalayo ukuze ulishintshe.
qs_hint_tap_available: Thepha ithayela elitholakalayo ukuze umiselele eligqanyisiwe.
recents_empty: Izinhlelo zokusebenza ozivula kule foni zivela lapha.
recents_usage_access_hint: Vula ukufinyelela kokusetshenziswa ukuze ufake izinhlelo zokusebenza eziqaliswe kwezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza (uhlu lwakamuva lwefoni).
setup_description: Izilungiselelo ezimbalwa ze-Android zidinga ukuvulwa ukuze i-MAD Launcher isebenze ngokugcwele. Thepha isinyathelo ukuze weqe uqonde kuso.
setup_reopen_hint: Vula kabusha noma nini nge-/ls → Izimvume & zokusetha.
setup_row_home_title: Setha i-MAD Launcher njengohlelo lwakho lokusebenza lwasekhaya
setup_row_home_why: Yilokhu empeleni okuthatha indawo yesikrini sakho sasekhaya sesitoko. Ngaphandle kwayo, ukucindezela okuthi Ikhaya ngeke kuveze noma yikuphi kwalokhu.
setup_row_listener_why: Izaziso zangempela, izithonjana ezingafundiwe, impendulo engaphakathi kwewindi, nama-chip emidiya aqhubekayo konke kudinga ukufinyelela kwesaziso.
setup_row_overlay_why: Vula lokhu ukuze amawindi esaziso antantayo namanothi anamathelayo ahlale phezu kwezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza.
setup_row_a11y_why: Insimbi eyindilinga negiya kuhlala kubha ye-nav yesistimu enezinkinobho ezingu-3 kulo lonke uhlelo lokusebenza. Okuqukethwe kwesikrini akufundiwe.
setup_row_contacts_why: Action Box ibonisa imicu yohlelo lokusebenza yakamuva kuqala, bese kuba oxhumana nabo befoni be-@ # *.
setup_row_post_why: Isikhumbuzi sendawo esithosiwe esivela ku-MAD Launcher.
setup_row_battery_why: Keeps umlaleli kanye nembondela ye-nav ekubulaweni buthule ngemuva.
setup_row_usage_why: Lets Recents and Iningi elisetshenziswayo lihlanganisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezivulwe kwezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza — uhlu olufanayo Android elugcinayo kusikrini sokubuka konke.
setup_row_location_why: Indawo emaholoholo kuphela, ukuze iwijethi yesimo sezulu sasekhaya ingabonisa izinga lokushisa langempela.
setup_row_read_sms_why: Ukubuyela emuva lapho ifoni yakho ingabonisi i-SMS ekufinyeleleni kwezaziso — izibalo ezingafundiwe, imigqa yemilayezo engu-MAD, nomsindo wokuxwayisa ovela ebhokisini lokungenayo le-SMS.
help_app_search_desc: Uhlobo : bese kuba isibizo sohlelo lokusebenza (isb. :yt). Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezinosesho lwangaphakathi nohlelo kuphela.
help_at_desc: Khetha uhlelo lokusebenza lokuthumela imiyalezo noma lwe-imeyili, bese oxhumana naye — Ibhokisi lesenzo livula leyo ngxoxo elungele ukuthayipha. Iziteketiso: txt, umbhalo, umlayezo, umlayezo, imeyili, i-imeyili, thumela.
help_social_desc: Khetha uhlelo lokusebenza lomphakathi olufakiwe (kuhlanganise ne-Facebook) - Ibhokisi lesenzo livula umqambi. Akukho okuthunyelwe okuzenzakalelayo.
help_contact_lookup_desc: Thayipha & noma thintana ne-Space — khetha umuntu, bese ufaka uhlelo lokusebenza ozothumela umyalezo noma umshayele.
help_group_desc: Uhlobo ? bese umbuzo wakho; khetha umsizi uma eziningana zifakiwe. Iziteketiso: ai, buza ai.
no_ai_assistants: Abekho abasizi be-AI abatholiwe. Faka i-ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Copilot, noma okufanayo.
contact_lookup_banner: Thola oxhumana naye, bese uthumela umyalezo noma ushayele
contact_lookup_pick_app: %1$s — khetha umlayezo noma shayela uhlelo lokusebenza
help_call_desc: Khetha uhlelo lokusebenza lokushaya ucingo (Ifoni, i-WhatsApp, Isilayezi, ...), bese kuba yingxoxo yakamuva. Iziteketiso: shayela, shayela, ucingo.
help_video_call_desc: Khetha uhlelo lokusebenza lokushaya ngevidiyo, bese kuba nengxoxo yakamuva. Iziteketiso: vid, ividiyo.
help_note_desc: Thayipha /n bese Isikhala — khetha uhlelo lokusebenza lwamanothi (Keep, njll.) bese udala inothi lapho.
help_add_contact_desc: Thayipha /a noma engeza othintana naye bese u-Space — igama nenombolo ozikhethela yona, bese ukhetha uhlelo lwakho lokusebenza Loxhumana Nabo. Ivula isikrini sothintana naye.
help_translate_desc: Thayipha /t, trans, noma humusha bese Isikhala — inkambu icacisa umbhalo wakho. Ongakukhetha: kusuka esiNgisini kuya eSpanishi. Ukuhumusha kusebenza kule foni, noma khetha uhlelo lokusebenza lomhumushi.
help_sticky_desc: Igcina inothi elinamathelayo esikrinini sasekhaya. Ayizivuli ezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza.
help_reminder_desc: Ivula iWashi. /r noma remind, bese milk in 20 min kwisilawuli sesikhathi, noma pickup at 8pm kwi-alamu.
help_launcher_settings_desc: Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhethwayo, kanye nokusethwa kwezimvume &.
help_action_box_settings_desc: Imiyalo yakho, amagama akhelwe ngaphakathi, uhlu lwezinhlelo zokusebenza, nezimvume.
help_settings_search_desc: Usesho lwezilungiselelo ze-OEM zomzamo omkhulu kakhulu.
help_update_desc: Ivula i-GetApps noma i-Google Play Isitolo ohlwini lwezibuyekezo. Thepha okuthi Buyekeza konke lapho - I-MAD ayikwazi ukufaka izibuyekezo ngemuva.
help_nav_desc: Thayipha /g noma hamba ke Isikhala — inkambu ivula indawo. zulazula, zulazula, bese uya emsebenzini omile. Khetha i-Maps noma i-Waze uma ifakiwe.
dock_auto_hide_hint: Idokhi ifihliwe ngebha yokudonsa ekhombisayo. Swayipha noma thepha ibha ukuze uvule.
dock_auto_hide_bottom_warning: Ibha yokudonsa ingaphazamisa ukuvula idrowa lohlelo lokusebenza.
dock_show_over_apps_hint: Keeps le dokhi noma ibha yayo yokudonsa esikrinini ngenkathi usebenzisa ezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza. Idinga imvume yokudonsa.
frequent_usage_access_hint: Vula ukufinyelela kokusetshenziswa ukuze uthole izinga eligcwele kuyo yonke i-Android.
frequent_empty: Sebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza futhi i-MAD izophina ezimatasatasa lapha ngokuzenzakalelayo.
settings_gestures_hint: Ukuthinta kwesiqalisi nezinqamuleli ze-nav kuhabhu yezilungiselelo eziyinhloko.
settings_home_notif_description: Uhlelo lokusebenza lwasekhaya, ukufinyelela kwezaziso, izimbondela, ukufinyeleleka, abathintwayo, nebhethri.
settings_nav_description: Lesi siqalisi sisebenzisa izinkinobho ezi-3 zokuzulazula. Ukuzulazula ngokuthinta akusekelwe.
settings_hub_nav_subtitle: Izinkinobho Android Zakudala noma izinkinobho ze-nav-bar
settings_experimental_intro: Lezi ezengeziwe zithatha indawo ethi Okwakamuva Kwesistimu, umthunzi wezaziso, kanye Nezilungiselelo Ezisheshayo. Zivalwe ngokuzenzakalelayo ngoba azisebenzi ngokuthembekile kumafoni amaningi.
settings_experimental_mad_windows: Izaziso ze-MAD kanye nezilungiselelo ezisheshayo windows
settings_experimental_mad_windows_off: Valiwe: Izaziso zivula umthunzi wesaziso. Izilungiselelo ezisheshayo zivula umthunzi onwetshiwe (okufana nokuswayiphela phansi kabili).
settings_experimental_mad_windows_on: Vuliwe: Imilayezo, izinhlelo zokusebenza zesistimu &, kanye nezilungiselelo ezisheshayo zivula amawindi e-MAD esikhundleni somthunzi wesistimu.
settings_experimental_help_window_off: Valiwe: /h ihlelwa ngaphansi kokuthi Hlela idokhi/s → Izilungiselelo ze-ActionBox. Alikho iwindi losizo elintantayo.
settings_experimental_help_window_on: Vuliwe:/h ivula uhlu oluntantayo lwemiyalo yebhokisi lesenzo.
settings_experimental_widget_badges_off: Off: the MAD clock widget does not show unread app icons.
settings_experimental_widget_badges_on: On: unread app icons appear on the MAD clock widget.
settings_experimental_mad_recents_off: Valiwe: Okwakamuva (i-pinch-out kanye nezenzo Zakamuva) ivula Uhlolojikelele lwefoni.
settings_experimental_mad_recents_on: Vuliwe: Okwakamuva kuvula iwindi lezinhlelo zokusebenza zakamuva ze-MAD. Ukufinyelela ukusetshenziswa kugcwalisa uhlu oluvela kwezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza.
settings_experimental_nav_shortcuts_off: Valiwe: azikho izinkinobho zokumbondela kubha ye-nav, futhi i-MAD ayikubambi ompompi be-nav. Ukubekwa kuhlala kulondoloziwe.
settings_experimental_nav_shortcuts_on: Vuliwe: izinkinobho zokumbondela kanye nompompi be-nav zisebenzisa ukubeka kwakho. Zihlele ngezansi.
settings_experimental_need_grants_body: Lokhu kudinga izimvume ezengeziwe. Vula isibonelelo ngasinye esishodayo, bese ubuyela lapha. Ukukhansela kushiya kuvaliwe.
compat_upload_body: Igama lokuzikhethela, i-imeyili, namanothi. Qinisekisa ukuthumela i-.txt kanye ne-.json kufolda yemibiko ye-MAD GitHub.
platform_intro: I-MAD ijwayelana ne-OS yefoni yakho. Izici ezikhawulelwe zihlala zisebenziseka kodwa kungenzeka zingabonakali kahle umthunzi wesitoko.
platform_partial_sync_body: Ezinye izexwayiso zingase zingafani nebha yesimo kule ROM. Cashisa nge-MAD kungase kungawususi umthunzi wesistimu.
platform_permissions_warning: %1$d izici zikhawulelwe kule divayisi. Thepha ukuze uthole imininingwane.
setup_row_xiaomi_autostart_why: I-autostart yohlelo lokusebenza lokuvikeleka igcina isaziso esibukweni nezinqamuleli ze-nav ziphila ngemva kokuqalisa kabusha.
setup_row_xiaomi_battery_why: HyperOS ivame ukubulala abalaleli bangemuva. Setha i-MAD ekusetshenzisweni kwebhethri okungakhawulelwe.
compat_selftest_waiting: Qedela izimvume ezidingekayo ngenhla — bese i-MAD iqalisa ukuzihlola kokusebenzisana lapha.
compat_selftest_subtitle: Helps MAD learn what works on your phone. Re-runs as you grant permissions. Report is optional but appreciated.
compat_github_hint: Hlola kabusha kuphela kuqalisa kabusha uphenyo. Ukulayisha kuthumela ukuzihlola ku-GitHub reports/compat. Imibiko yesiphazamisi isebenzisa Okungeziwe.
settings_palette_hint: Uhlelo lulandela ukulungiselelwa okumnyama nokukhanyayo kwefoni. I-Nord ne-Wallpaper isashintshana nayo.
settings_landscape_rotate_hint: Layout stays put — nothing scales or slides. Icons and names turn together in place. MAD clock stays stacked (clock, date, weather) and fills its cell; wide third-party strips stay as drawn. Leave off on tablets.
settings_infinite_home_pages_hint: Ngemva kwekhasi lokugcina, swayipha ukugoqa uye kwelokuqala (futhi ngokuphambene nalokho).
settings_page_grid_hint: Igridi yamakhasi asekhaya, Esetshenziswa kakhulu, kanye nekhabethe lohlelo lokusebenza. Ukukhishwa kwekhasi ngalinye kumenyu yokwenza ngendlela oyifisayo.
settings_icon_size_hint: Usayizi wesithonjana ngaphakathi kweseli yegridi ngayinye emakhasini asekhaya, Okusetshenziswa kakhulu, kanye nekhabethe lohlelo lokusebenza.
settings_icon_bg_hint: Fades the app’s own icon fill. The glyph stays solid.
settings_no_wallpaper_colors: Ayikho imibala yephephadonga etholiwe — setha isithombe sangemuva kuqala.
settings_nav_classic_hint: Ibha ye-nav evamile ye-Android. Azikho izinkinobho zokumbondela ze-MAD.
settings_nav_bar_hint: Izihlalo ezimbili kubha ye-nav; ezengeziwe zihlala emthunzini wesimo. Thepha umcibisholo ukuze ushintshe izihlalo.
gesture_landscape_enabled_hint: Vala ngokuzenzakalelayo ukuze igridi yasekhaya ikwazi ukuskrola iqonde kukwakheka kwezwe.
settings_hub_share_apk_subtitle: Link or QR for the public download APK
share_apk_hint: The GitHub download link only works if you are signed in to the private repo. Tap Send APK to share the public build (no distributor token) over WhatsApp, Nearby, or Bluetooth.
share_apk_send_failed: Could not prepare the public APK
extras_language_hint: Khetha iphakethe lolimi. Izinguquko zisebenza ngokushesha. Thola amaphakethe okulanda engeziwe kufolda ye-MAD GitHub lang.
extras_message_hint: Igama ongazikhethela lona ne-imeyili. Bhala iphutha, umbono, nanoma yini enye.
dock_second_row_hint: Swipe up on the dock (not the home screen) to slide it up and show another row of 5 apps. Swipe up on the dock again for the app drawer.
dock_side_size_immediate: Usayizi wedokhu oseceleni uyasebenza ngokushesha (akukho Faka isicelo).
settings_shape_applies_immediately: Isimo sisebenza ngokushesha ekhaya, idokhu, nekhabethe.
toast_updates_unavailable: Asikho isitolo sohlelo lokusebenza esitholelwe izibuyekezo
